x.page.title: Sky Atlas – al-Marṣad
x.lang.note: Arabic interface text: draft, awaiting review by the scholars. Names and source quotations stay as recorded.
x.sky.announce.chain.on: Stars are lit by their place in a narration chain: the nearer the Prophet ﷺ, the brighter. Stars in no recorded chain are plain.
x.sky.announce.cluster.on: Nearby stars merge into groups until you zoom in. Tap a group to fly into it.
x.sky.announce.cluster.off: Groups off: every star is drawn on its own.
x.sky.announce.gpu.on: Faster drawing on: the distant stars and test stars are drawn by the graphics card (WebGL).
x.sky.announce.gpu.off: Faster drawing off: everything is drawn by the ordinary canvas.
x.sky.announce.gpu.none: This browser has no WebGL, so the ordinary canvas keeps drawing.
x.sky.announce.globe.on: Globe: the places with recorded coordinates on a turning globe, with the record moving between them over time.
x.cluster.open: A group of {n} stars: flying in.
x.journeys.note: The camera flies stop by stop; the stars of the journey stay lit. Built in the page with the same selection rule as the learning journeys (drafts, not yet approved).
x.journey.hijrah.title: The Hijrah, step by step
x.journey.hijrah.lead: The events and story the record ties to the Hijrah, with their recorded parts, in date order.
x.journey.first_believers.title: The first believers
x.journey.first_believers.lead: The stories of the Makkan period from the 50 Stories document, in reading order, with the people each story names.
x.journey.badr.title: The people of Badr
x.journey.badr.lead: The battle, its story, then the people the record places there, the Prophet ﷺ first and then by name, and last those recorded as absent.
x.journey.why.named: Chosen because its name ties it to the journey.
x.journey.why.part: Chosen because the record names it as part of “{whole}”.
x.journey.why.story: Story {no} of the 50 Stories, in the Makkan period.
x.journey.empty: The record has nothing for this journey yet.
x.presence.title: Who was there, and who wasn't
x.presence.none_absent: No one is recorded as absent from this event yet. The Sky shows absence only where a record states it: silence is not absence.
x.presence.none_present: No one is recorded as there yet.
x.presence.note: Who was there is a highlight set from the sources entered so far, not a roster. On the sky, those recorded as absent carry a broken coral ring with a stroke through it.
x.chain.place: Narration chain: link {d} from the Prophet ﷺ in “{label}”.
x.chain.collector: Narration chain: the collector of “{label}”, {d} links from the Prophet ﷺ.
x.legend.chain.near: First narrator, nearest the Prophet ﷺ: brightest and coolest
x.legend.chain.far: Further down the chain: warmer and dimmer, one step at a time
x.legend.chain.none: In no recorded chain: plain, with no halo
x.legend.chain.note: Brightness follows how far someone sits from the Prophet ﷺ in a recorded chain of narration, and nothing else. The graph holds {n} chain so far, so most stars are plain in this mode; it grows as chains are added. It replaces generation light while it is on.
x.legend.more: Groups, absence, journeys and the globe
x.legend.cluster: A ring with a number: nearby stars merged into one group until you zoom in. Every group is the same size; the number is the only count.
x.legend.absent: Broken coral ring with a stroke: recorded as absent from the event in focus.
x.legend.trail: Gold dashed line with numbers: the stops of a guided journey, in order.
x.legend.test: Grey-blue pinpoints in the shells: test stars, only when you add a test load. Synthetic, not records: never in search, the panel or the text view.
x.legend.globe: Globe: coastlines from Natural Earth (public domain). Places sit at their recorded coordinates; gold arcs join the places of the record's dated events, one after another. An arc is the order of the record, not a route.
x.scale.label: Add test stars
x.scale.note: Test stars are synthetic points in the generation shells, to try grouping and faster drawing at the scale of thousands of Companions. They are not records.
x.scale.announce: {n} test stars added. Grouping is on.
x.perf: {ms} ms a frame · {fps} frames a second while moving · {n} stars · {mode}
x.globe.textalt: Globe view. Places with recorded coordinates: {list}. The record's dated events move between them in this order: {moves}.
x.textalt.presence: At {event}, recorded as there: {present}. Recorded as absent: {absent}.
